Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental historical error in the very first step of the task decomposition. The problem asks about the end of the civil war in which Kerensky was defeated by the Bolsheviks. Kerensky was the head of the Provisional Government which fell during the **October Revolution of 1917**. His defeat and the rise of the Bolsheviks effectively ended his power *in 1917*. The Russian Civil War (1917–1922) was the subsequent conflict between the Reds (Bolsheviks) and the Whites (including various anti-Bolshevik forces, some of whom were former Kerensky supporters, but Kerensky himself was already in exile by late 1917). The Planner incorrectly conflated Kerensky's defeat (1917) with the end of the entire Civil War (1922). By setting the goal to find when the civil war ended as the answer to "when Kerensky was defeated," the Planner established a false premise that led the WebSurfer to search for the 1922 date, resulting in the final incorrect answer.
